description: This file contains C source code related to protocol handling, message parsing, and UBUS communication in a software system, specifically for operations like getting protocol types, matching protocols, synchronizing requests via UBUS, and handling blob message data.

methods.name: bool proto_matches(unsigned int dm_type,const enum bbfdmd_type_enum type)
methods.description: Checks if the given dm_type matches the specified type, considering the special BBFDMD_BOTH and BBFDMD_NONE constants.
